about: Hand-judged verdicts for docs/audit/data/spotcheck-sample.json (seed 20261003). Fields judged per category: the key fields listed in the sample (identity: chip/model name, socket, memory type, form factor/size, capacity, kit, watts…). error = a field (or the model name, when it splits the listing from its product) contradicts the listing's title, URL or spec-cache entry; missing = the title/URL states a value but the field is null (not counted as an error); unclear = cannot be judged from the title/URL/spec cache. Notes marked 'general knowledge' use facts not in the title.
